title: Coat of Arms in the Pond
description: A heraldic coat of arms featuring a black knight's helmet crest topped with a large dragonfly sits above a white shield divided into three sections, each containing a golden pinecone. The shield is adorned with black filigree and floats above a calm blue pond with lily pads, its reflection visible in the water. A white banner reading 'Forct' emerges from the right side.
prompt: A heraldic coat of arms with a black knight helmet crest topped by a realistic dragonfly, positioned above a white shield containing three golden pinecones arranged in a triangular pattern. The shield has ornate black scrollwork on both sides. The entire crest appears to float over a tranquil blue pond filled with yellow lily pads and tall green reeds on the sides, with a perfect reflection visible in the still water. A white banner with the word 'Forct' floats to the right. Misty green background, serene atmosphere, detailed digital painting style.
